entities.summary: East India Company, a political institution in Singapore during Founding of Modern Singapore (1826–1867). Grew from Stamford Raffles and Raffles and the Free Port. Led to the emergence of Singapore becomes a Crown Colony directly under the Colonial Office and Opening of the Suez Canal dramatically increases Singapore's trade volumes.
